applies_to: coreav-isobmff-write extract_audio outputs through scripts/extract_check.py, ffprobe and ffmpeg 7.0.2, MediaInfo 26.10

conditions.output tkhd duration: = the sum of the output's edit durations, or without an edit list its media duration rounded to the nearest movie tick
conditions.MediaInfo Duration: output = its tkhd duration over its movie timescale; source = its tkhd duration or the media duration (the same in both files); to the millisecond

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.3.2 (the track duration is the sum of the durations of all of the track's edits); the source's edit list is copied

conditions.ffprobe packet lists: the same for source and output, and shorter than nb_frames

entries.basis: one packet per sample; samples are never dropped; the edit list is copied; as KD-EDIT-DISCARD

conditions.output edit list: the source's entries, timescales and rates included, every media time moved by the source's first stored decode time
conditions.ffprobe packet lists: the same for source and output, and longer than nb_frames

entries.basis: docs/design/edit-lists.md ("What `ffprobe` lists", rules 7 to 9: a preroll sample per media edit and samples repeated at the edits' boundaries); one packet per sample; docs/design/edit-list-writers.md, "M4A extraction" (the entries are copied)

conditions.source: no edit list on the track; an iTunSMPB tag whose delay + padding + samples = the media header duration
conditions.output edit list: one media edit starting at the tag's delay
conditions.start_pts and packet and frame times: source = output + delay; data hashes, sizes, frame durations and frame hashes equal
conditions.duration_ts and duration: source = delay + padding + samples, output = samples (time base 1/sample rate)

entries.basis: the tag's delay and length become an edit list when they add up exactly; ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 (the edit maps media time to presentation time 0)

conditions.source: an edit list and an iTunSMPB tag whose delay + padding + samples differ from the media header duration
conditions.framemd5: every source frame but the first and the last appears in order and unchanged in the output

entries.basis: the edit list is copied, and a tag that does not add up is ignored

conditions.packets: the last packet's duration is the same in both files
conditions.framemd5: every frame but the last is equal; the last has the same times, lasts the stored duration on the output and longer on the source

entries.basis: the sample durations are copied (ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.1.2 and 8.8.8); ffmpeg 9.0.2 cuts the last decoded frame to the stored duration on the output only

conditions.profile: source none, output LC, both aac
conditions.configuration: byte-identical (the coreav round trip compares the stored esds)

entries.basis: the esds is copied as stored; as KD-AAC-LC-UNNAMED

conditions.rate: ffprobe's source sample_rate (the decoded rate) = the output's media timescale = the output's sample_rate, a whole multiple above 1 of the source's media timescale
conditions.time_base: source 1/(its media timescale), output 1/(the decoded rate)
conditions.values: output start_pts, duration_ts and every packet's pts and dts = the source's times the multiple; packet hashes and sizes equal

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 12.2.3.3 (an audio timescale matches the sampling rate or is an integer multiple of it); ISO/IEC 14496-3 1.6.5.2 (an HE-AAC decoder outputs SBR's rate); docs/design/edit-list-writers.md, HE-AAC timescale
